summary: The diff implements substantial fixes across all four requirements. REQ-1 (invoice generation), REQ-2 (delivery assignment), REQ-3 (QR scan flow), and REQ-4 (QR code display/print) all have corresponding changes. However, a few specific acceptance criteria have partial or unclear coverage, and one notable gap exists in how QRCodeDisplay generates its URL.

missing_requirements.requirement: QRCodeDisplay must generate the QR image URL using the VITALIST-prefix + base64-encoded order ID format so that a scanned QR from QRCodeDisplay resolves correctly to the backend order
missing_requirements.reason: QRCodeDisplay.tsx calls generateQRCodeURL(orderId, size) passing the raw orderId directly, without using the stored qrCode.value as InvoiceView does with 'order.qrCode?.value ?? order.orderId'. There is no evidence the component uses the stored QR value, meaning a displayed QR may encode a different value than what the decoder expects.

missing_requirements.requirement: REQ-3 AC: The DistributorWorkflowDialog barcode scan step correctly resolves the scanned order and proceeds to the image upload step when the decoded value matches the order
missing_requirements.reason: DistributorWorkflowDialog.tsx checks if the decoded value !== order.orderId after BarcodeScanStep already calls decodeQRData. If the stored orderId does not match the decoded output of decodeQRData (e.g. raw vs prefixed format), this comparison would incorrectly reject valid scans. The diff does not definitively resolve this potential mismatch.

hallucinated_features.description: WorkflowStageIndicator component with WORKFLOW_STAGES progress UI
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention adding or modifying a WorkflowStageIndicator component or a workflow stage progress bar UI. This appears to be an unrequested UI addition not covered by any requirement.
